prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image1 is an UNAPPROVED empty recovery-plate edit target; Image2 is the exact1x2 geometry reference. Create one corrected complete NE recovery plate in the same cream/gray/charcoal/ochre M1 materials.

Correct TWO issues: make the plate rim HALF as thick, and flatten the ground-plane projection to exact2:1 dimetric camera,26.565 degrees rather than30-degree isometric. The plate's total projected floor width must be exactly TWICE its projected floor depth. Both world axes have horizontal run twice vertical rise; keep two identical cells down-right and one identical cell down-left.

At1024-square guide scale the physical BASE corners are NORTH(448,350), EAST(704,478), SOUTH(576,542), WEST(320,414). Preserve this exact equal-cell1x2 shape. The metal plate is only8px thick above these contacts, a very thin shallow frame, no thick foundation extrusion or flared feet. No surrounding floor/apron.

Keep the pale broken rectangular recovery outline in the first cell, a clean empty second cell, small flush ochre corner fittings, coherent gray panels and upper-left light. No service arm, motor housing, tower, cargo, pod, vehicle or extra hardware. One EMPTY recovery plate only.

Square1024x1024canvas, object centred with wide real transparent margins on every side, complete unclipped corners. No guide colours, labels, text, numbers, border, magenta, ground shadow, scenery, road, water, extra plate or other view. Generate a new corrected original; no masks or painted-out clipping.

actual native1x2 contact/projection target, not artwork
